senses.definition: The recoil of an object bouncing off another.
A return to health or well-being; a recovery.
An effort to recover from a setback.
(colloquial) The period of getting over a recently ended romantic relationship.

quotes.text: "I get it. Girl caught him on the rebound when he was vulnerable."
